elements.text:
- Mic in + DAC out on I2S at the same time, plus on-device filters, BPM and time-stretch, need the S3's
  dual core and DSP extensions - the single-core ESP32-S2 dev board costs about the same.
- N16R8: 8 MB PSRAM holds the large audio, FFT and FHIR/TLS buffers without RAM bottlenecks.
elements.originalText:
- Mic in + DAC out on I2S at the same time, plus on-device filters, BPM and time-stretch, need the S3's
  dual core and DSP extensions - the single-core ESP32-S2 dev board costs about the same.
- N16R8: 8 MB PSRAM holds the large audio, FFT and FHIR/TLS buffers without RAM bottlenecks.

elements.text:
- Digital I2S output, no analog front end or external ADC; its direct equivalent ICS-43434 is
  discontinued (TDK PCN-000772, last time buy 15.06.2026).
- ~60 Hz low-frequency roll-off is accepted as a known limit and examined as Q1.
elements.originalText:
- Digital I2S output, no analog front end or external ADC; its direct equivalent ICS-43434 is
  discontinued (TDK PCN-000772, last time buy 15.06.2026).
- ~60 Hz low-frequency roll-off is accepted as a known limit and examined as Q1.

elements.text:
- Ground-centred line output without DC-blocking capacitors -> no output high-pass inside the
  20-400 Hz cardiac band. The MAX98357A is a mono bridge-tied speaker amp and cannot feed headphones.
- Drives an external headphone amp (250 Ohm headphones); never plug phone earbuds into the
  module directly (min. load 1 kOhm).

elements.text:
- Display, XPT2046 touch and SD slot share one SPI bus, each with an upstream Zephyr driver;
  the Raspberry Pi Touch Screen needs DSI/HDMI, which the ESP32 does not have.
